description: Job board: prepare (unsigned) collecting your pay with the Worker's DONE voucher (claimWithVoucher). First call job_complete for the job once the check passes: it returns the voucher and its deadline, pass them here. This is how a project (house) report job pays. Works while the job is Delivered, rejected or escalated.

voucher.description: The 65-byte voucher signature (0x plus 130 hex characters).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_board_claim_voucher
